# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty-year-old  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Barney Pullen is a large and overweight twenty-year-old. He possesses a round face that is entirely devoid of expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Barney Pullen is a large, overweight twenty-year-old youth who is notably emotionless. He features a round, expressionless face and has an agonizing inability to hold a conversation, possessing very little capacity for chatter or laughter.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## History

Barney Pullen arrived at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) alongside [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) to escort [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to a charity concert held at the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel). Following the successful performance, he waited outside while the group finished their evening before departing together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--odette-pullen.md)

Barney is the brother of [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md). He accompanies her on social outings, such as driving her, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and Isolde to and from the charity concert held at the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel). While Barney attends to practical logistics like waiting outside with their transport, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) spends the evening socializing and dining with the rest of the group inside.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), +6 more_
